# deps: tools: up gofumpt to v0.4.0

Pin `gofumpt` (the stricter `gofmt`, kept in the Go toolset) at v0.4.0, following [[DOT-274]] (v0.3.1). The upgrade is a change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), installed via [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go). The release notes are the [v0.4.0 tag](https://github.com/mvdan/gofumpt/releases/tag/v0.4.0).
